outcome: Understand why player cohorts disengage and test helpful, non-manipulative retention interventions with explainable cohort insight
overview: Live-operations teams can see retention falling in aggregate dashboards, but not why particular cohorts disengage — so campaigns stay broad, content is wasted and acquisition spend climbs. This solution builds a governed player-cohort layer over consented game telemetry, explains churn drivers per cohort, and lets LiveOps test helpful, non-manipulative interventions against holdouts, with children and vulnerable-player signals excluded by design. A 6–10-week pilot on one title validates D7/D30 retention lift, fewer irrelevant contacts and stable wellbeing measures before any wider rollout. Reference builds are specified for AWS and Azure, with Gulf data residency and Arabic-language delivery supported for regional studios and publishers.

notFor.why: Without controlled tests, retention lift cannot be honestly attributed to interventions
Child-safety rules prohibit engagement-pressure mechanics for minors; the solution excludes child cohorts by design, so a child-first title has no eligible audience

Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, game-analytics data scientist, LiveOps consultant; customer LiveOps owner, analytics lead, privacy and player-safety reviewers · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
